rationale: wezterm-font now compiles in the GPUI graph (ADR 0003). The wezterm-gui glyph atlas lives in window/ textures + glium; that cannot move into GPUI without a custom Element and GPU atlas. For the POC, rasterize with LoadedFont, composite a viewport RGBA buffer, paint with Window::paint_image. Consolas GPUI text remains the fallback if FontConfiguration or rasterize fails. Not a window/ cutover.
